en:
The pool could not have been the scene of
the murder. Ryoma was killed at <CLT=cltSTRONG>nighttime<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

<CLT=cltSTRONG>No swimming is allowed at nighttime<CLT=cltNORMAL>,
so a living person could not have gone in.

Yep! A dead body is fine cuz it's just an object.
But if a living person entered the pool...
I think I might cry!

Cry as loud as you want. I'll cry with you.
We can spend the night together, crying...

And the morning after, I'll write "goodbye" on
your mirror in lipstick before I quietly leave.

Only after you leave do I realize how
much you really mean to me...

Quit bein' so gloomy! This is the year of
the Jets! Fuck the Patriots!

Anyway...we can conclude it's impossible 
for him to have drowned in the pool.

Where was Ryoma killed if not pool? Is there
other place where water can be stored?

<CLT=cltMIND>Where was Ryoma killed?
I know there's some kind of clue...

The handcuffs found in the tank...
They were from Ryoma's lab.

Handcuffs can be taken anywhere. I think we need
stronger evidence to determine the crime scene...

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

There was that piece of black fabric found
in the pool. Possibly Ryoma's clothing...

You just said he wasn't killed
in the pool.

I won't let you take back 
your words that easily!

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

The cable from the tennis net in
Ryoma's lab was pulled out...

What's that gotta do with Ryoma's drowned body!?
Sit down, shut up, and pull your own cable!

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

Why are you so quiet? Were you just pretending 
to know this whole time?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

I've no clue what you mean. Such confusing 
arguments will only bring about your doom.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

What clue shows where
Ryoma was killed?

The sink in Ryoma's lab. There were
distinct scratch marks on it.
...Scratch marks on the sink?

And I believe those scratches
were caused by...

The square glass pane.
It was scratched as well, correct?

But that was from my lab.
Why would it be in Ryoma's sink?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

The window frame scraping
against the sink.

The window frame...? In the sink?
How would that even work...?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

If I got a closer look at the scratches, I can
determine the material that caused them...

I don't think there's anything special about
the scratches. What if we look elsewhere?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

The tennis net cable was removed.
Perhaps that was involved...

You can't scratch up a sink with a cable!
Now, whips and chains on the other hand...

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

There must be a reason.
Just hurry up and tell us.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

You think that caused the scratch marks on the
sink? I have no idea what you're trying to say.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

If Ryoma was drowned in the sink,
what made the scratches?

...the <CLT=cltSTRONG>handcuffs<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
They were scratched as well, correct?

Oh yeah. It sorta looked like they'd
been scraped against something.

There's also the fact that the handcuffs
were from Ryoma's lab.

The marks on the sink came from the
handcuffs in the same room.

The size and shape of the scratches are
consistent with the handcuffs. I'm sure.

Hmmm... How did those handcuffs get from the
lab to the water tank?
Because Ryoma was wearing them, right?

Yes, though they were only visible for a brief
moment when Ryoma appeared in the tank...

I am certain he was wearing the handcuffs
at the time.

The handcuffs were left after the
piranhas devoured Ryoma.

So the culprit handcuffed Ryoma and
drowned him in his lab's sink.

Ryoma must've been pretty yummy. They chomped
up his entire body—arms, legs, brain...

Stop saying disgusting things,
I don't wanna hear it!

That crunchy texture with the fatty parts just 
right. Then, when they bite down, it gushes—
STOP, PLEASE STOP!!!
But...how did culprit handcuff Ryoma?

He coulda used Shukuchi Method to get
away. Unless someone ambush him?

It's possible they knocked him out
before handcuffing him...

Kehehe... Though there's no way we can 
be sure, now that he's naught but bones.

I doubt he was ambushed.
I'm pretty sure the culprit got Ryoma by...

Oh whoops, don't pay attention to little ol' me.
I'm just talking to myself.

When you talk to yourself, pretend you're
eating and chew with your mouth closed.

Otherwise, you'll get a mouthful of peanut
butter squid. It's so disgusting, you'll laugh!

So we all agree Ryoma was drowned in
the sink in his lab, right?

That sink coulda held enough
water to do it, for sure.

Alright, I'm calling it! The crime scene is
Ryoma's fuckin' research lab!

But how did the culprit carry his body
to the gym from there?

Isn't Ryoma's lab on the 3rd floor of
the academy?
It's actually not far at all.

Although, perhaps it's more accurate
to say...there's a <CLT=cltSTRONG>shortcut<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
Was there a shortcut...?

<CLT=cltMIND>What shortcut between Ryoma's lab
and the gym did the culprit use?
Ah...there?

Eh...? What are you saying...
all of a sudden?

Are you bein' vague on purpose? When you say
"there," do you mean...*there*?
Are you flirtin' with me, virgin?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
The monitor was connected to the gym.

Entering and leaving through the monitor
would be a mysterious miracle, indeed!

But that goes against the laws of science,
so it's impossible!

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
There was some trick to the handcuffs.

Whaaaat? Even Atua doesn't know
what you're talking about.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

There was a hidden passage
in the shower.

The showers there were pretty normal. 
We checked them, remember?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

There was a hidden passage
in the sink.

C'mon, man! You can't just say whatever 
you want just cuz it's a crime scene.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

There was a hidden passage
under the pile of clothes.

That'd be interesting, but I've never 
heard of a prison break plan like that.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
Hey, hey... Where's the shortcut?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

What shortcut connected Ryoma's lab
and the gym?
The shortcut is the <CLT=cltSTRONG>window<CLT=cltNORMAL> in Ryoma's lab.
The window?

That's right. None of the windows
in this school open...
except the one in Ryoma's lab.

And on top of that, the window faced the
pool. You could see the gym straight across.

Do you think the culprit dropped Ryoma's body
into the pool area from the lab window!?

Then they could've thrown the body into the
piranha tank through the gym window...
How's that!? Mission complete!

Your explanation contradicts some things we 
discussed earlier.

The gym window was too high to reach from the
pool side, even if one used the ladder.

That's right! I apologize! I must go
on a journey to reflect on this!

We keep hitting dead ends, since we don't
know how the body was thrown into the gym...

Nee-heehee... Well, that didn't really give us 
any info about the crime.

<CLT=cltMIND>Not necessarily...
We learned a lot of important information.

<CLT=cltMIND>Now that I'm sure the scene of the crime
was Ryoma's lab, the case is becoming clearer.

<CLT=cltMIND>To determine how the body got from the
crime scene to where it was found...

<CLT=cltMIND>I have to figure out how to get from the
third floor window to the gym.

<CLT=cltMIND>Alright then. I have to analyze the
possible methods and find the most likely!
